summary:
The NBA’s site is nba.com. The red-and-blue silhouette in the tab is the icon game bookmarks request, distinct from a team’s own favicon.

Checked 12 November 2026 against nba.com. HTML came from https://www.nba.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.nba.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 1150 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.nba.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #223377 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 7949 bytes) from https://www.nba.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
